## Security fixes

Please upgrade, in particular if agents or integrations work with read-only keys or sign-ins.

- **Read-only credentials and the live editor connection.** A read-only API token or a read-only signed-in agent could change the text of any page its account may edit, through the connection the editor uses for live collaboration. That connection opens like a read, so the gate that refuses read-only credentials every write never saw it. A read-only credential may still follow a page live, but i

## Fixes

- **A connector keeps its sign-in when two renewals overlap.** Hosted connectors renew from several machines at once. Since 1.1.5 the second of two renewals was refused, Claude took that for a revoked connection, and the connector stayed out of scheduled runs until somebody connected it again, while chats kept working if its address carried a token. ## Fixes

- **A wide board can be scrolled sideways with a mouse** (#98, thanks @letelba). The board had no scrollbar, and its bottom edge sat below the window, so the columns past the right edge could only be reached with a trackpad. The board now ends inside the window and shows a quiet bar when its columns overflow, wherever there is a mouse. The collection toolbar wraps onto a second row instead of cutting off Filter, Sort and New when there are many views or the window is narrow.

## Fixes

- **Search finds pages for two or more words again** (#107, thanks @ymbroxe). As soon as one word of a search had a second spelling (a shortened stem, or ss for a sharp s), the query was one the search index refuses, and the refusal came back as "no results". Most searches of two words found nothing, German ones above all.
- **Line breaks in a text property survive a click** (#108, thanks @ymbroxe). Clicking into a value and leaving it saved the value without its line breaks, even without typing.

## Security fix

- **Read-only tokens and templates.** A read-only API token could save any page its account may write as a template over MCP (`save_as_template`): the tool was missing from the list of writing tools the token scope is checked against. That list now names the reading tools instead, so a tool missing from it is refused to a read-only token rather than let through, and a test runs every tool in the catalogue against a read-only token. - 会话白名单：只收你列出的会话（群填形如 `12345@chatroom` 的 id，私聊填对方 wxid）；不填就一条都不收。

Inbox: a search box of its own. Type to narrow what is waiting there by title, summary, site, author or link, without your own notes mixed in. The button beside the add box now reads Save.
Whiteboard: a card's preview now uses the same font, size and colour as when it is being edited, so the text no longer changes when you open a card.

No more keychain prompts on Mac
On macOS, Folio no longer asks to access your keychain after every update. Its keys (sync, AI providers, the backup copy) now live in a private file in the app's own folder. The first launch after this update asks one last time for each key, to move it over; choose Allow.

Open source under AGPL-3.0
Folio is now open source under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0; the licence ships with the source. No changes to the app itself since 0.1.30.

Query blocks
New: a query block lists the tasks, blocks or cards that match your conditions and keeps itself up to date. Type /query (or /查询) to add one, pick a common query or set conditions, or write it as text such as task:open #project due:<=+7d. Tasks can be ticked and rescheduled in the results. Renaming a tag also renames it inside queries. The slash menu now also opens with the full-width ／ typed by Chinese input methods. Chinese input and Android shares
Typing Chinese into an empty bullet no longer leaves the pinyin behind with the chosen characters on a new line (macOS). On Android, a link shared to Folio while it was in the background is no longer sometimes lost; going back and installing updates also work after Android has closed Folio's screen in the background. Debug builds take less disk space, and scripts/clean-target.sh clears old build output.

Quotes and symbols in AI edits
Accepting an AI change to a paragraph no longer turns quotes, &, < and > into codes like ". Paragraphs changed by 0.1.27 keep the codes until edited by hand.
